title: Hi, my name is Martha: Using names to measure and mitigate bias in generative dialogue models
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. The authors explicitly mention that analyzing how their methods perform on reducing biases related to other demographics, such as religion, is an area for future work.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on measuring and mitigating gender and race/ethnicity bias in generative dialogue models, primarily by observing how models react to first names associated with these demographic groups.
